slides.escena: Yadira's avatar looks surprised and amused, holding a giant rounded 3D smartphone that shows a big chat bubble icon with a small red 'x' mark. A small cute pink-and-white helper robot peeks from behind her shoulder. Soft sparkles around.

slides.texto: Empieza con «Actúa como experto en…». La IA ajusta el tono, el nivel y los ejemplos a ese rol.
slides.escena: Yadira's avatar places a tiny graduation cap on the cute pink helper robot, which smiles proudly. A floating 3D chat bubble icon next to them.
Yadira's avatar points at a floating holographic white board with three simple pink icons (a person, a target, a speech bubble), explaining like a friendly teacher.

slides.texto: Tabla, lista, correo o guion: dile cómo quieres la respuesta y te ahorrarás editarla después.
slides.escena: Yadira's avatar juggles three floating 3D cards: one with a table icon, one with a list icon, one with an envelope icon. Playful and confident expression.

slides.texto: Pega un texto que te guste y pide «escribe en este estilo». Copiará el tono mucho mejor.
slides.escena: Yadira's avatar hands a pink paper sheet icon to the cute helper robot, who scans it with a soft glowing pink light from its eyes.

slides.texto: Al terminar, escribe «hazlo más corto y claro» o «dame tres versiones». La segunda respuesta casi siempre gana.
slides.escena: Yadira's avatar gives a thumbs up next to three floating 3D chat bubbles growing from small to big, with sparkles on the biggest one.

slides.texto: Sígueme en @yadira.official para aprender IA cada día
slides.escena: Yadira's avatar waves warmly at the viewer with a big smile, the cute pink helper robot waves too, floating 3D hearts and sparkles around them.
